newsitem.title: UK: UK EU-harmonised CPI +1.7% in year to June.
newsitem.headline: UK EU-harmonised CPI +1.7% in year to June.

text.p: Britain's harmonised index of consumer prices (HICP) rose 1.7 percent in the year to June, compared with 1.6 percent year-on-year in May, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
The HICP is calculated by each member state of the European Union for the purposes of international comparison in the context of the convergence criteria laid out in the Maastricht Treaty.
The index rose to 102.0 in June from 101.8 in May.
